message.content:
This image is a **screenshot** of a digital interface (likely from a blockchain or gaming platform) displaying a **voting proposal** for a "Staking Boost" event. Here’s a detailed breakdown:  


### 1. Header & Status Elements  
- Top-left: A purple badge with `PACK_PERKS` (stylized with a chain icon) and a green `ACTIVE` tag, indicating the proposal is live.  
- Top-right: A clock icon with `23h 57m left`, showing the time remaining for the vote.  


### 2. Proposal Title & Description  
- Title: `STAKING BOOST: 2X rewards for 5 days` (bold, white text).  
- Description:  
  - `PACK PERKS PROPOSAL` (with wolf emojis) introduces the event: *“For the next 5 days, ALL staking rewards are DOUBLED!”*  
  - Reward breakdown (current → boosted):  
    - Bronze: `3 → 6 pts/day` (bronze medal icon)  
    - Silver: `8 → 16 pts/day` (silver medal icon)  
    - Gold: `20 → 40 pts/day` (gold medal icon)  
    - Diamond: `40 → 80 pts/day` (diamond icon)  
  - Call to action: *“5 DAYS OF DOUBLE POINTS. Stack hard or stay behind. This is the moment to hold. Every day counts double. Vote YES to double the rewards.”*  
  - Token: `$DOOMHOUND` (with a wolf emoji).  


### 3. Voting Results & Progress  
- `YES 217 pts` (green text) vs. `NO 0 pts` (red text).  
- A green progress bar (full, indicating “YES” is leading).  
- `Quorum: 1/5` (minimum voters needed) and `Approval: 100% / 50%` (current approval vs. required threshold).  


### 4. Voting Power Section  
- `VOTING POWER` (gray text) with a value of `3648 / 3648 pts` (red text, indicating full voting power).  
- A slider (set to “MAX,” with a red dot) and buttons: `1 pt`, `25%`, `50%`, `75%`, `MAX` (red button, selected).  
- Note: `Points committed will be deducted from your balance` (yellow text, warning about vote cost).  


### 5. Vote Buttons  
- Green button: `✓ YES (3648)` (selected, indicating the user’s vote).  
- Red button: `✗ NO (3648)` (unselected).  


### 6. Timeline  
- `Created 19 May 2026, 12:04` (when the proposal launched).  
- `Ends 20 May 2026, 12:04` (when voting closes).  


### 7. UI & Design  
- Dark theme (black background) with high-contrast text (white, green, red) for readability.  
- Icons (medals, wolf, clock, checkmark, X) and color-coding (green for “YES,” red for “NO”) guide user interaction.  


This interface is designed to let users vote on a temporary staking reward boost, with clear visuals for progress, voting power, and deadlines.
